text:
Most people's first sight of Kyoto isn't a temple. It's this: Kyoto Tower, glowing across the road from the station 🗼

Step out of the Karasuma (north) side and it's right there, which is how you know you've picked the exit for the city buses.

Have you seen it lit up at night? 🌙

#Kyoto #KyotoTower #KyotoStation #JapanTravel
